falsePositiveDefinition: A no_result query counts as a false positive when the system returns ANY hit, including fuzzy hits. Unprocessable-query errors count as correct abstention. For other categories, irrelevant hits in the top 5 are reported as precision@5 and are not hidden.
tuning: Weights and thresholds may be tuned on split=dev only; split=test is reported once per parameter version. Changing corpus, labels or targets creates a new corpus version and the old results are reported alongside.

targets.note: approved: Success@1 = 1.00 when a service is supplied
approved: both services returned when unscoped
reported only; input to the semantic-local decision
approved ceiling; any returned hit, including fuzzy, is a false positive; not to be loosened without coordinator approval

targets.rule: not lower than baseline; any exception is reported explicitly

latency.note: p50/p95 recorded per run with machine details; never asserted in permanent tests
